tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ bla ma rdor 'dzin 'jam mgon spyan ras gzigs// rnal rgyal sgrol ma 'od zer can sogs la// gus pas phyag 'tshal bdag ni skyabs su mchi// deng nas mchog thob bar du thugs rjes skyobs// gang zhig spros bral nam mkha' dang mtshungs la// dpe med bde chen bde bas yongs gang zhing*// yid bzhin nor ltar 'gro ba'i re skong ba// bdag med mkha' 'gro'i gtso la mgos phyag 'tshal// rgyal srid spangs te dpal ldan na len+d+rar// gzhi kun yod smra'i sde la rab byung ste// gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol son gyur nas// kun gyi mgon po gnas brtan chos skyong mchog /sgrub la brtson tshe mtshan gcig bdag med mas// snyan brgyud bzhis gdams de tshe sa drug mnan// de nyid bstan dang dman rnams bsgral bya'i phyir// nyid kyis bir+war zhal bzhes grong du gshegs// gaṅgā bzlog cing gdug can rgyal po dang*// nyi ma bzung ste yul khams bco brgyad kyi// myos byed rab gsol dbang phyug liṅga bkas// gtum mo bcom zhing smin drug bu yang btul// de sogs 'gro ba'i don mang mdzad nas kyang*// rdo rje gsum mchog thugs dang dbyer med pa// dpal ldan bir+wa pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gu lang spangs te dpal ldan rjes 'brang ba// rdo rje'i tshig gnang tshe na de nyid gzigs// 'gro ba 'dul phyir brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad// shar phyogs nag po pa la phyag 'tshal lo// ma ga dhār 'khrungs don dam gzigs pa po// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ḍā ma ru pa ni// 'gro ba ma lus 'dren par mdzad pa po// rtag tu gzhan don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dad pas bla ma'i zhabs drung nyer bsten te// 'khor ba bsgral phyir sgrub la brtson mdzad pas// de nyid rtogs pa a wa dhū ti pa// gnyis med spyod pa mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya'i mtha' kun rab tu sbyangs gyur nas// gangs can 'gro ba gdul phyir brtson pa po// dpal gyi ri rtser 'pho bas mkha' la gshegs// ga ya dha ra'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// skad gnyis smra ba'i rje btsun thugs rje can// gsung ngag rin chen zab mo'i nyi zla yis// skal ldan rnams kyi blo yi mun sel ba// shākya ye shes gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i zhabs drung du mar dka' ba spyad// gsang rgyud kun gyi man ngag 'dzin pa po// nus mthu mnga' ba'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog

/rig pa'i mtha' can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba bsgral phyir sgrub la brtson pa po// ting 'dzin sprul pa du mas brgyan pa'i sku// chos kyi de nyid gzigs pa'i bla ma ni// 'bar ba'i mtha' can de la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni nges par rdo rje 'chang dbang ste// skal ldan don du mi yi gzugs 'dzin pa// rkang gnyis gtso bor 'gro ba'i bla ma mdzad// dpal ldan sa skya pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig 'gro kun thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// yongs bzung dga' bas snying po 'dren mdzad cing*// dngos po kun la zhen pa mi mnga' ba'i// bla ma snying rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni man ngag du ma'i mdzod 'dzin pa// dad pas nyid kyi zhabs drung lhags pa rnams// skal bzhin mkhas dang grub pa'i sar 'god pa// 'gro ba sgrol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sku des 'gro ba'i don mang mdzad nas kyang*// sa stag tha skar dkar po'i bcu bzhi la// dpa' tshogs kyis bsdus slar yang rdor 'dzin gyur// khyed la thal mo sbyar nas skyabs su mchi// gang zhig bsod nams du mas bsgrubs pa po// 'gro kun mya ngan 'das rtser 'jog mdzad cing*// shes bya'i mtha' kun mkhyen pa rab rgyas pa// thugs rjer ldan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rdor 'dzin gnyis med gzigs pa po// brgyud par ldan pa'i man ngag 'dzin pa ni// kun gyi gtsug tor mchog gyur byang sems ldan// bla ma rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dad pas bla ma'i zhabs drung nyer bsten nas// rgyu dang man ngag du ma mnos gyur te// tshul khrims sdom ldan bsgrub la brtson pa po// bdag sogs 'dren par grags la phyag 'tshal lo// de sogs brgyud pa dang ni mngon sum du// rjes su ston par mdzad pa'i bla ma rnams// nges par sangs rgyas yin yang gdul bya'i phyir// tha mal lus 'dzin khyed la skyabs su mchi// dngos su 'byor dang bdag pos ma bzung ba'i// yid kyis sprul dang bdag la ci mchis pa// bdag nyid kyang ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bla chen khyed kyi thugs rjes 'di bzhes shig

/thog med dus nas bzung ste bdag gis ni// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nyes bgyis pa// bgyid du stsal dang de la yi rang ba'i// sdig de nongs par bshags shing slar yang bsdam// rgyal dang de sras rnams dang rang rgyal dang*// mos pa gzhan dang 'gro ba gzhan rnams kyang*// dge ba bgyid pa de rnams thams cad la// dad pas bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// 'gro ba gti mug thibs pos mdongs rnams kyi// ling tog bsal bar ma gyur de srid du// rdo rje theg sogs chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /kun nas bskor bar bdag ni gsol ba 'debs// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can ji snyed pa// mya ngan 'das par rab tu gzhag par du// rang bzhin dbyings su mya ngan mi 'da' bar// thal mo sbyar nas bdag ni gsol ba 'debs// phyag dang mchod dang sdig pa bshags pa dang*// yi rang bskul dang gsol ba btab pa las// dge ba'i dngos po bdag la ci mchis pa// des ni 'gro rnams sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bdag kyang khyod kyi thugs rjes rtag bzung ste// tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i gnas 'gro mdzod// min na 'chi kha bar dor mchog thob par// thal mo sbyar nas khyod la gsol ba 'debs// gzhan yang skye ba 'di nas bzung nas ni// ji srid bde chen sa la gnas bar du// khyod kyi zhabs kyi drung du rtag skye zhing*// rab tu dgyes pas rtag tu byin rlabs mdzod// bdag gis mkha' 'dra ma thob bar du yang*// sbyin dang sdom brtson bzod dang ting 'dzin dang*// shes rab snying brtse byang chub sems ldan zhing*// lam gyi bar chad rnams dang bral bar shog /'gro kun dga' byed snying po'i chos ston zhing*// bsod nams kun gyi rtser gyur sgrub byed pa// rnal 'byor kun gyi gtsug tor mchog rgyal dang*// tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i zhabs bsten shog /bla ma'i zhabs pad gus par rtag bsten pas// dgyes pa'i thugs rje chen pos bdag bzung ste// rdo rje theg sogs gzhung mang spyod pa dang*// snyan brgyud bzhi dang rtag tu ldan par shog

/spang bya'i sde rnams kun dang 'khon gyur te// rab dga' la sogs sa yi mchog gyur pa// zla ba ku mud ltar skya thob gyur nas// sa bcu'i rgyal sras rnams dang 'grogs par shog /rnal 'byor 'dis ni rgyal ba thob ces pa'i// snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs kun rgyas gyur te// bdud dpung sder bcas yi mug spa bkong nas// thar pa'i rgyal mtshan myur du slong bar shog /rgyal sras rnams dang rtag tu rol byed pa'i// rdo rje'i lus su gyur cing rab dga' bas// blo mchog rnams dang 'grogs shing bshad pa'i sgras// rdo rje dril bus rol zhing 'gying bar shog /bdag gis de ltar thob par gyur nas ni// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa yi// thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i ded dpon rgyal por shog /blo chen rnams kyi thugs rje'i stobs dang ni// bdag gi dad pa'i stobs dang bsod nams kyis// ji ltar smon lam btab pa de bzhin du// bdag dang 'gro bas rab tu 'grub par shog /shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis// dad pa'i stobs kyis bstod la sogs pa 'di// shing rta'i smin drug dkar po'i tshes gcig la// gtsang stod dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas su bgyis// rje btsun bla ma'i tshogs la dad pa'i blo gros shin tu brtan pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
